title: GASP: Efficient Black-Box Generation of Adversarial Suffixes for Jailbreaking LLMs

layout.note: A tall gradient bar named SuffixLLM stands in the middle for the full height. Four lettered sections sit round it on white: A (pre-training) top-left, C (inference and refinement) bottom-left, B (training and alignment) top-right, D (results) bottom-right. Arrows run between the bar and the sections: from the AdvSuffixes into it, from it to token strips, and long arrows with a yellow ORPO pill that return to it.

lesson: When several stages all act on one model, draw that model as one tall central bar and hang the lettered stages on both sides, so every arrow visibly starts or ends at the same object; show what a stage does to it with sketched density curves (baseline to aligned, matched to the target).
